result.topic_en: Riemann sets up the Riemann invariants p, q for one-dimensional gas flow, transforms the hodograph problem into the linear equation $\partial^2 w/\partial p\partial q + \partial w/\partial p + \partial w/\partial q = 0$ with Cauchy data on a curve, and works out the Green's-type integration by parts with an adjoint function v (the start of the Riemann function method).
